author: jochembrouwer
content:
Hey all! I have read the specs, most look good but I have a few points:

> If that address has a nonzero nonce or a nonzero code length, the creation fails as specified in EIP-684, and the nonce of the TCREATE account is still incremented.

My main problem is TCREATE + CREATE. The motivation seems to be that we can deposit arbitrary code at a predetermined address (via TCREATE+CREATE). This itself seems like a legitimate use case to me. But, EIP states that if we then try to redeploy (CREATE from TCREATE) then if there is a collission the TCREATE nonce still gets incremented. This does not happen in EIP-684 (a collission will not increase nonce). So this practically means you can only CREATE once from the TCREATEd address if we follow EIP-684 rules, because the next time this is tried then we run in a collission (except if the CREATEd account SELFDESTRUCTs, but...:)

The EIP also seems to hint at TCREATE+CREATE+SELFDESTRUCT patterns, but note that we really want to remove SELFDESTRUCT so the EIP should not advertise use cases for this. I'd rather directly ship EIP-4758 together with TCREATE.

What is the use case of TCREATE+CREATE? I just want to note that this device thus can be used once to deploy arbitrary code at a specific address. The next attempt (should) run into this collission.

-----

For gas accounting: 

> Any operation that modifies the balance of the target account of a TCREATE operation, including during contract initialization, performs state-gas accounting according to the following table.

I think this should be clarified further. So, if I CALL from the TCREATEd account and remove all my balance (the account did not exist prior to this transaction), then I refill the state reservoir (but, this stacks with whatever CALL does, so if this creates a new account then this cancels)

Is this correct?

author: jochembrouwer
content: The EIP also does not state how the TCREATEd account behaves for the opcodes EXTCODESIZE/EXTCODECOPY/EXTCODEHASH (for the deployed TCREATE account) and CODECOPY/CODESIZE for the code running in TCREATE

author: milonite
content:
Thanks for the review

1. Nonce: that is already today's rule. A colliding CREATE bumps the creator's nonce (EELS, geth). EIP-684 only makes the create fail. The EIP just repeated it, now it says "as for any other account that executes CREATE". And yes, each child address is single-use. After a collision the next CREATE goes to the nonce-2 address.

2. Use case: CREATE3 with cleanup. The 0x Settler, 1inch and Aave/BGD deployers do CREATE2 shim → CREATE → shim SELFDESTRUCT today. With TCREATE the shim leaves nothing in state.

re this, this is the only use case I found. Because it's not for trading, I think it's not really important. I know we should just allow use cases regardless, but if reduce complexity i'm OK with dropping it. 

3. SELFDESTRUCT: agree. Those passages were warnings written for EIP-6780, I reworded them for EIP-4758. +1 on shipping 4758 together with TCREATE.

4. Gas: yes, correct. Balance back to zero refills one new-account charge (183,600 state gas). The CALL charge for a new recipient is separate, so the two cancel. I added "first matching row applies" and your example.

5. Code opcodes: good catch, it was only implied by "identical to CREATE2". Same as CREATE2 during the tx, no code after it. There is a section for it now.

Draft PR with all of this: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12721

will review internally the draft
